newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World airlines propose 3 pct ticket price rise.
newsitem.headline: World airlines propose 3 pct ticket price rise.

text.p: International airline officials on Friday proposed a three percent ticket price rise from December 15 after three days of discussions to hike prices for passengers to make up for rising fuel costs, the International Air Transport Association (IATA) said.
IATA also said in a statement that the proposals were subject to government approvals.

The statement said the proposed global increase in passenger fares would go some way to contributing to restoring industry profitability.
The proposed increase would apply to fares agreed through IATA's multilateral process. The date for the increase was December 15 subject to government approvals, it said.

Head of tariff affairs at the 251-member global airlines body, Patrick Murphy, told Reuters the fare increases were in response to a 40 percent rise in fuel prices, around 10 percent of most airlines' costs, this year.

Some European carriers have already announced ticket price hikes so there would be exceptions in Europe and rises would be lower, he said. Other exceptions included Greece and Canada, which had proposed a five percent increase each, he added.
